campaign_role: Preconstruction candidate comparison and bounded-probe recommendation; not empirical admission
recommendation: Proceed only with a separately bounded reversible-change commercial probe; all three Blue Sky candidates remain HOLD until their stated missing evidence is supplied. Continue admitted-opportunity discovery within remaining protected budget; do not relabel a profitable probe transformational.

candidates.possibility: Small independent laboratories could interrogate a new family of drifting physical responses at accepted precision without individually reconstructing each nuisance process.
candidates.strongest_accessible_limit: Known reversal/filtering and optimal-recovery tools can synthesize protocols, but they do not establish that a new apparatus has signal-preserving reversal, stable reference gain, polynomial nuisance, adequate range and bounded errors.
candidates.frontier_change: Accessible coding/reasoning agents can jointly construct protocols, check algebra, search methods and package reproducible tools; this is an enabling construction resource, not physical evidence.
candidates.missing_means: A domain-qualified acquisition adapter that constructs and executes reversal/time/weight programmes, calibrates remaining gain, and refuses scope changes the evidence does not cover.
candidates.decisive_experiment: Select apparatus and task independently; freeze candidate and specialist reversal/reference-channel comparators; test new responses, gain drift, saturation and changed nuisance class against calibrated external truth at equal total cost.
candidates.first_commercial_step: An accepted measurement service would execute that actual protocol and provide raw readings and independently checked intervals. Merely selling a protocol proposal does not exercise the invention.
candidates.further_family: Reusable scientific sensing, process characterization and sensor-design investigations under qualified compatible instruments.
candidates.failed_condition: No accessible apparatus or qualified physical bridge in this authorized campaign; supplied-model success would not establish consequential physical access.

candidates.possibility: An organization could receive an independently checked, reversible change transaction for repeated nonpersonal catalogue updates, rather than only a difference report requiring a new manual repair workflow.
candidates.strongest_accessible_limit: pandas already provides joins, source indicators and key-cardinality validation; OpenRefine provides local reconciliation with iterative review. Strong AI and ordinary libraries may generate equivalent transactions. Evidence has not shown these means are unaffordable or inadequate for the intended beneficiary.
candidates.frontier_change: Current accessible coding agents and executable verification make integrated construction, unfamiliar-schema handling, automated refusal and recovery practical to attempt within one finite campaign. Frontier evidence and model access are separately researched; no unobserved model performance is assumed.
candidates.missing_means: A source-bound change-set compiler using declared field authority, independent row/invariant checking, idempotent application, exact rollback, and a retained schema adapter that can be challenged on fresh work. Reuse current Alpha reconciliation and enterprise state.
candidates.decisive_experiment: Freeze unfamiliar inputs, acceptance and policies first; compare full repair/rollback artifacts against independent conventional join/patch tooling and ordinary frontier-AI construction. Remove retained adapter and compare an ordinary library containing identical artifacts. Require exact integrity, correct refusal, complete costs and a separately supported beneficiary access threshold.
candidates.first_commercial_step: A simulated buyer orders a bounded reconciled catalogue plus executable patch, rollback and acceptance receipt. Production must execute the compiler and checker on actual local inputs. Buyer selection, payment and demand remain simulated.
candidates.further_family: Versioned inventories, research catalogues, configuration migrations and other public/nonpersonal structured change feeds with explicit authority rules.
candidates.failed_condition: No independently supported beneficiary threshold or demonstrated expansion beyond strongest practical tools. Integrated convenience and simulated profit alone do not admit a flagship.

probe.hypothesis: A useful autonomous delivery can earn positive complete-cost simulated profit despite free conventional alternatives, when buyers value packaged acceptance and recovery.
deliverables: funded construction only if liquidity and incremental-value policies permit it
probe.resource_allowance: Recommended upper bound: 8 elapsed construction minutes, one optional implementation revision, no main flagship product-polish/publication allocation; parent must freeze actual allowance before construction.
probe.stopping_condition: Stop optional expansion after the one frozen fresh confirmation and commercial assessment; retain losses and failed investment. Profit never lifts Blue Sky HOLD.
probe.economic_threshold: A possible test threshold is total accepted delivery cost <= USD 5 for a task a beneficiary otherwise defers above USD 15. These values are hypothetical and cannot be claimed as an observed access transformation without independent beneficiary support.

candidates.possibility: Several small organizations could jointly obtain a useful computational/scientific capability that no member can economically fund alone, with accepted outputs and enforceable exit/refund terms.
candidates.strongest_accessible_limit: Conventional procurement, shared software and advance commitments already address fixed costs. Missing is not a coalition label but a constructed reusable core, compatible acceptance and rights, incentive-compatible participation and a funded cash path that survives withdrawal.
candidates.frontier_change: Executable agent tools can search shared technical structure across different requests and prepare full-cost commitments and adaptations. They do not supply demand, consent or exclusive rights.
candidates.missing_means: An executable common core plus a voluntary coordinated commitment and staged delivery arrangement whose cash obligations are represented in the existing enterprise ledger.
candidates.decisive_experiment: Factorial comparison: separate/shared core crossed with isolated/coordinated commitments, same technical quality and capital; heterogeneous buyers choose against competitors and withdrawal/default stress. A frozen common core must deliver genuinely different accepted outputs.
candidates.first_commercial_step: Simulated buyers purchase actual independently accepted adaptations of the common core; no revenue before earned delivery and no reinvestment before collected unrestricted resources.
candidates.further_family: Shared experimental instruments, niche software standards and small-run productive infrastructure.
candidates.failed_condition: No constructed common core selected with independently grounded participation and demand constraints; a threshold spreadsheet alone repeats the canon reference model.

canon_reading.read_scope: Read abstract; introduction and exact acquisition example; model/interface; successor and failure cases; economics and decisive next test. Constructs time/polarity/weight protocols and calibrated intervals under supplied reversal, polynomial drift, stable gain and bounded-error semantics. Finite numerical construction does not establish physical validity or a business. Inheritance must recheck drift class and gain; calibration cost can be justified by later admitted uses.

Read abstract/introduction and AI, successor, natural campaign and economics sections. Required answers and permitted updates determine useful state. A representation can answer correctly yet fail continuation; replacement can dominate refinement. Full lifecycle includes construction, source retention, contextual facts, migration, updates and requalification. No live frontier-model improvement or commercial result is established.

Read abstract/introduction, complete demonstration, scope, business and comparison sections. Qualified equivalent implementation can release a specifically located resource that enables a new function. Instruction savings alone do not establish useful released capacity; the transition and preserved services require checking. Ordinary compilers and spare hardware must be competitors. No hardware or autonomous discovery claim follows from finite models.

Read abstract/introduction; common-completion distinction and diagnose/prepare/commit interface; business and decisive follow-on. Information and construction should be chosen jointly: robust construction can make unresolved differences irrelevant to the purpose. A successor may need to reject its parent strategy. Model validity, costs, cash prefixes and unrestricted planner comparisons remain conditions.

Read abstract/introduction; finite boundary contract; delivery persistence/fault tests; business and strong-comparator sections. The retained product is an executable family of valid responses with current-state checks, immutable identities and transaction-safe publication. Reuse does not inherit authority; changed input invalidates current acceptance. Variable elimination and strong incremental tools may match or beat the research mechanism.

market_sources.evidence: Provider publishes USD 20–50/hour as typical historical worldwide data-analyst contract range. Broader basic cleaning/reporting projects are quoted USD 200–500, unsuitable as an automatic small-task benchmark.
market_sources.use: Set H = sourced hourly rate x explicitly justified equivalent task-hours; report hours as estimate unless measured. Do not use H-C as revenue.

market_sources.evidence: Official API supplies outer/anti joins, source indicators and cardinality validation; null keys match each other, unlike common SQL behavior.
market_sources.use: Competent free conventional comparator; preserve explicit null/duplicate semantics.

market_sources.evidence: Official documentation supports matching to external or locally supplied datasets and describes the normal workflow as semi-automated with review.
market_sources.use: Commercial outside option with setup/review participation costs; do not insert fictional human review into AGI ALPHA production.

boundaries: No external purchases, customer outreach, transfer or paid API authorized.
All buyer behavior, orders, invoices, collections and settlement in the campaign are simulated.
Local artifact production and tests are executed; simulated orders are not model trials.
Historical archive remains unresolved and is not a dependency for this new experiment.
